_comment: TDD M4 reverse named-effort slice: validated canonical override enum admits the requested literal, carried by name to Chat reasoning_effort. Future-expected (source: router_metadata canonical override + reasoning.py exact same-enum). RED on baseline: hard refusal 400 invalid_generation_parameter, zero upstream IO.
name: m4_reasoning_responses_chat_override_admits_literal
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.chatup]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"

[[models]]
name = "bridge-resp"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o-mini"

[capabilities.overrides."bridge-resp".reasoning.effort]
supported = true
values = ["low", "medium", "high"]
default = "medium"
native_parameter = { protocol = "openai-chat", path = "reasoning_effort" }
